Job Title: Digital Marketing Manager
Location: Mumbai

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to lead our performance marketing and content strategy.

Key Responsibilities:
- Plan and execute multi-channel digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and email
- Manage SEO and content marketing strategy to grow organic traffic
- Analyze campaign performance using Google Analytics (GA4) and build weekly dashboards
- Manage a monthly marketing budget and optimize ROAS and customer acquisition cost
- Run A/B testing on landing pages to improve conversion rate
- Work with sales and product teams on go-to-market launches

Requirements:
- 4-6 years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS
- Proven experience with HubSpot or Salesforce marketing automation
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency in Excel
- Excellent written communication and stakeholder management
- MBA in Marketing is a plus
